_meta.notes: 3 parallel agents — commercial + open-source + benchmarks. First music sweep — dashboard had zero music gen coverage.
sources: Stable Audio 2.5 + Stable Audio Open + Open 2 + Stable Audio 3 Small/Medium/Large

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Music Arena (Instrumental)
benchmarks.description: Blind crowdsourced pairwise preference ratings for instrumental music generation; Elo rating system.

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Music Arena (Vocals)
benchmarks.description: Blind crowdsourced pairwise preference ratings for music-with-vocals generation; Elo rating system.

benchmarks.name: Music Arena (CMU/Sony AI)
benchmarks.description: Open live evaluation platform for text-to-music (arXiv 2507.20900). Music Arena project at music-arena.org.

benchmarks.name: MusicCaps FAD-CLAP
benchmarks.description: Frechet Audio Distance over MusicCaps reference using CLAP music-trained embeddings (MA checkpoint).

benchmarks.name: MusicCaps CLAP Score
benchmarks.description: Text-audio alignment score using LAION-CLAP music checkpoint.

benchmarks.name: SongBench
benchmarks.description: Fine-grained 7-aspect song quality benchmark (Vocal, Instrument, Melody, Structure, Arrangement, Mixing, Musicality) over 11,717 expert-annotated samples.

benchmarks.name: MMAR (Multi-disciplinary Audio Reasoning) — Overall
benchmarks.description: 1,000-item deep audio reasoning benchmark across speech, sound, music, and mixed modalities. NeurIPS 2025.

benchmarks.name: Interspeech 2026 Audio Reasoning Challenge — MMAR-Rubrics
benchmarks.description: First shared task on Chain-of-Thought quality in audio domain. 156 teams. Single Model + Agent tracks.

benchmarks.name: MUSDB18-HQ — Average SDR
benchmarks.description: Average SDR across vocals/drums/bass/other on MUSDB18-HQ test set. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: ICASSP 2026 SongEval Challenge — Track 1 (Overall Musicality)
benchmarks.description: 2,399 full-length songs, 5 aesthetic dimensions. Track 1 = overall musicality.

benchmarks.name: CMU Music Arena — Arena Score
benchmarks.description: CMU G-CLef Music Arena. Live TTM crowdsourced eval. Launched July 28 2025. SEPARATE FROM AA Music Arena.
